description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling function overloads, including generating effective overload sets based on argument types and optionality, as well as grouping methods by name. It appears to be part of a codebase related to WebIDL processing or similar overload resolution logic.

classes.name: OverloadSetAdapter
classes.description: Base class defining the interface for argument handling in overload set calculations.

classes.name: MethodContextAdapter
classes.description: Subclass of OverloadSetAdapter that provides concrete implementations for handling method arguments, types, optionality, and variadic status.

methods.name: sort_and_groupby
methods.description: Sorts a list and groups items by a key, returning a generator of (key, list) pairs.

methods.name: effective_overload_set
methods.description: Computes the effective overload set for a list of functions, considering argument types and optionality, following WebIDL overload resolution rules.

methods.name: effective_overload_set_by_length
methods.description: Groups overloads by the length of their argument type lists.

methods.name: method_overloads_by_name
methods.description: Groups methods by name, returning only those with multiple overloads.
